title: Disability Compensation Dependents: Age Limits, Reporting Window and Reporting Channels
content:
The following values govern who can be recognized as a child or school child on a Disability Compensation award, how long after a family event a dependency claim keeps the event date, and which kinds of report are accepted by telephone. They are the same at every tier, from Disability Compensation (10% Combined Rating) through Disability Compensation (100% Combined Rating).

| Item | Value at every tier |
|---|---|
| Child age limit | 18 years; a child stops being recognized as a minor child the day before the 18th birthday |
| School-child minimum age | 18 years; from this age a child attending an approved school can be recognized as a school child |
| School-child age limit | 23 years; school-child recognition ends the day before the 23rd birthday |
| Dependency report window | 365 calendar days after a marriage, birth or adoption; a dependency claim received within it takes the event date as its effective date |
| School child paid as a dependent for the same months the child is paid Chapter 35 education benefits | Not permitted |
| Oral report by telephone accepted to reduce or discontinue a dependent addition | Yes |
| Oral report by telephone accepted to add a dependent | No |

**Questions the table answers**

*Can a telephone report add a newborn child to the award?* No. A telephone report is not accepted to add a dependent at any tier.

*Can a telephone report remove a former spouse after a divorce?* Yes. A report that reduces or discontinues a dependent addition is accepted orally at every tier.

*Hypothetical illustration of the age limits:* a child born on 10 May 2008 is recognized as a minor child through 9 May 2026, the day before the 18th birthday; if enrolled at an approved school, the same child can be recognized as a school child from the 18th birthday until 9 May 2031, the day before the 23rd birthday.

*Hypothetical illustration of the reporting window:* for a marriage on 1 March 2025, a dependency claim received on or before 1 March 2026 is within 365 calendar days after the event.
